description:
Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.

Marcom is the creatively-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.

Marcom's Interactive Engineering team works on many high-impact projects that serve various Apple lines of business. We use the latest in open source technologies and continue to evolve and deliver solutions on a worldwide scale. Working with a variety of multi-functional teams, the Interactive Engineering group brings it all together to deliver the interactive experiences with an excellent group of software engineers while having fun along the way. This team is exciting and fast-paced; it’s a great place for people with exacting standards who want their work to matter.

Description
We are looking for a Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience to design, develop, and enhance modern, distributed, scalable, and high-performance Content Management Systems (CMS) using Java, open-source technologies, and modern software engineering practices. This role is critical to the evolution of Apple’s brand as you will be working with the teams taking apple.com to the next phase of its evolution. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building modern CMS platforms, solving complex content management problems at scale, and leveraging AI-assisted engineering and agentic workflows to improve both CMS capabilities and software development productivity.

This role provides an opportunity to build modern, distributed, and large-scale Content Management Systems that power apple.com and enable content to be created, managed, governed, and delivered across multiple digital experiences.

You will work across Java backend services, CMS platforms, content architecture, content modeling, workflows, APIs, integrations, search, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and AI-powered engineering workflows.

The role is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex CMS problems at scale and is excited about the evolution of CMS platforms through headless architectures, open-source technologies, automation, and AI agents.

The primary focus of this role is CMS engineering.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, customize, and extend the distributed, large-scale CMS platforms that power apple.com and other Apple digital experiences, supporting high volumes of content.
Build and enhance capabilities across the content lifecycle, including content creation, modeling, relationships, metadata, taxonomy, workflows, approvals, versioning, localization, publishing, and delivery.
Work hands-on with Java-based open-source CMS platforms and frameworks and extend their capabilities to meet evolving product and business requirements.
Design and develop headless and API-first CMS solutions enabling content delivery across web, mobile, and other digital channels.
Develop and integrate REST and GraphQL APIs for content authoring, management, preview, search, and delivery using Java and Spring Boot.
Build integrations between CMS platforms and search, digital asset management, identity, analytics, CDN, and other enterprise systems.
Design solutions for scalability, high availability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and efficient content delivery in distributed environments.
Implement caching, indexing, asynchronous processing, and event-driven mechanisms for large-scale CMS workloads.
Work with databases and data models supporting large content repositories and efficient content retrieval.
Develop and maintain supporting backend services and microservices in Java, using Spring Boot and related frameworks, based on the CMS architecture.
Deploy and operate CMS services using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.
Troubleshoot and resolve CMS, performance, scalability, integration, and production issues, including JVM-level performance and memory tuning.
Develop unit, integration, and API tests using JUnit and related Java testing frameworks, and contribute to CI/CD and engineering automation.
Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement of the CMS platform.
Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.
Explore and build AI-powered capabilities and agentic workflows for CMS use cases, where appropriate.
Collaborate with product managers, architects, frontend engineers, DevOps teams, and content stakeholders.

Minimum qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience, with a focus on fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
3+ years of professional software development experience building scalable, highly available backend and web applications in Java.
Hands-on experience with Java-based CMS or content platforms and their extension APIs.
Experience with DAM or PIM solutions and integrations supporting content-as-a-service at scale.
Strong hands-on experience with Java (Java 11 or later) and the Spring / Spring Boot ecosystem, including dependency injection, Spring MVC, and Spring Data.
Experience designing and developing RESTful and/or GraphQL web services in Java.
Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and data modeling for content-heavy applications.
Experience with Java build and CI/CD tooling such as Maven or Gradle, Git, and Jenkins.
Experience writing unit and integration tests with JUnit, Mockito, or similar frameworks.

Preferred qualifications
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms for deploying JVM services.
Experience with caching and search technologies such as Redis, Memcached, Elasticsearch, or Solr.
Experience with event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging systems.
Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React / Vue / Angular) for CMS authoring interfaces.
Hands-on experience using AI/ML tools and AI coding assistants to accelerate development, testing, and operational excellence.
